synthesis_intent.registers: Common scalar/control registers; only the active AES 128-bit and SHA eight-word working state remain wide. RSA operands are SRAM limbs.
synthesis_intent.reset: Asynchronous validity reset followed by parallel write-zero/readback of banks 2-5 and explicit FIFO payload erasure; reset never initializes a SRAM array directly.
synthesis_intent.clock_enable: PCLK only; no gated clock. Tagged fixed-latency SRAM retirements control engine progress.
synthesis_intent.memory: Exactly six tc_sram_1024x32 banks on IHP130; explicit macro-disabled synchronous fallback; only 8x37, 8x37 and 16x37 Common FIFOs may infer production storage.
synthesis_intent.pipeline: One access per bank/cycle. AES owns banks 0/2, SHA owns 1/3, RSA owns 4/5; APB accesses idle owners and maintenance takes priority. P2 physical qualification remains pending.
